pairs.subject: health-checks
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/health/health-page/healthActions.ts:66 The demo marks a check healthy after recording an action without verifying recovery, so its success indication does not meet the remediation standard.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/health/health-page/useSystemHealth.ts:22 The traced fetcher reads demo snapshots; mounting this hook does not launch dependency checks, and there is no operational check cadence to judge here.
src/lib/healthFormat.ts:44 The section summary uses worst-of and exposes member rows, but its aggregation vocabulary cannot represent undetermined members or report their coverage.
src/hooks/useDemoOnlySWR.ts:20 SWR caches static demonstration data, not observed dependency verdicts; operational probe TTL and freshness requirements have no target here.
src/lib/mockApi.ts:532 The health source projects fixtures rather than interacting with dependencies, so probe depth, deadlines and cancellation are not exercised.

src/components/dashboard/views/health/health-page/healthActions.ts:66 Configure/install affordances exist, but completing the simulated action directly produces green and removes the button without a confirming check.

src/lib/mock-dashboard-data.ts:1446 The check model provides severity labels rather than distinct verified, failed and unverifiable outcomes with state-specific evidence; info is used for unconfigured or disabled integrations.
